def forward(groups):
    year, month, day, sp1, hour, minute, second, millis = groups
    dt_text = f"{year}-{month}-{day} {hour}:{minute}:{second}.{millis}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(dt_text, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = int(layout[0])
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    timestamp = dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
    date, time = timestamp.split(' ')
    year, month, day = date.split('-')
    hour, minute, second = time.split(':')
    millis = second.split('.')[1]
    second = second.split('.')[0]
    return f"{year}-{month}-{day}" + (' ' * sp1_len) + f"{hour}:{minute}:{second},{millis}"

def forward(groups):
    major, minor, build, revision = map(int, groups)
    packed_version = (major << 48) | (minor << 32) | (build << 16) | revision
    return {'stored': [packed_version], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    packed_version = record['stored'][0]
    major = (packed_version >> 48) & 0xFFFF
    minor = (packed_version >> 32) & 0xFFFF
    build = (packed_version >> 16) & 0xFFFF
    revision = packed_version & 0xFFFF
    return f"{major}.{minor}.{build}.{revision}"
